item: kit catalogue sheet, batch 2b (tab bar, tabs, segmented, chips, tiles, locked, toggle, slider), at phone size
critique: Raised controls (selected segments and chips, toggles, teal tiles, day chips) show a top-lit gradient, a gloss band, a dark hue-matched rim and a solid lip; the parchment 'Day 4 of 7' panel has a bevelled frame and inner wells; nothing is posterised. Pressed and disabled faces are flatter, and the high-contrast tab bar is a flat fill with a light outline whose bottom edge is cropped in the still, so its lip could not be checked.

item: kit catalogue sheet, batch 2b (tab bar, tabs, segmented, chips, tiles, locked, toggle, slider), at phone size
critique: Words on textured surfaces ('Spirit', 'Locked', 'Lv 9'), the tab bar labels and On/Off carry a full unbroken ink outline in both modes, and the day numbers share one treatment; the sheet has no headline figure. Note: white chip and segment labels are outlined on some plates (All, Time) and not on others (Weekly, Season, Motion).

item: kit catalogue sheet, batch 2b (tab bar, tabs, segmented, chips, tiles, locked, toggle, slider), at phone size
critique: The main action's gold fill is also used for selected segments ('Daily', 'Hard'), selected filter chips ('Motion', 'Energy'), claimed day tiles 1 to 3 and one chart bar in 'Day 4 of 7', which is told from its purple neighbours by hue alone; the same selected state turns brown on the parchment ground. The version 2 ruling names this as gold in a second role; the pass anchor keeps gold to frames, rims and numerals. The school chips carry no school colour or shape.

item: kit catalogue sheet, batch 2b (tab bar, tabs, segmented, chips, tiles, locked, toggle, slider), at phone size
critique: Judged as kit art on its own light: every raised control and tile has a top highlight with a darker lip and drop below, recessed tracks are shaded at the top under the same light, and nothing is lit from below. The high-contrast stills are flat by design.
